description: This file provides configuration and parameter handling for Azure OpenAI O-series models within the Responses API. It defines a class 'AzureOpenAIOSeriesResponsesAPIConfig' that customizes behavior such as supported parameters and parameter mapping for O-series models (like o1, o3). It handles dropping unsupported parameters like 'temperature' and checking if a model belongs to the O-series.

classes.name: AzureOpenAIOSeriesResponsesAPIConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for handling Azure OpenAI O-series models in the Responses API, including managing supported parameters and special behavior such as dropping unsupported parameters like 'temperature'.

methods.name: list get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of supported parameters for a given O-series model, filtering out parameters like 'temperature' which are unsupported by O-series models.

methods.name: Dict map_openai_params( self, response_api_optional_params: ResponsesAPIOptionalRequestParams, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps optional request parameters, removing 'temperature' if 'drop_params' is True for O-series models, with logging.

methods.name: bool is_o_series_model(self, model: str)
methods.description: Determines if a model is an O-series model based on its name or features.

ctags.signature: ( self, response_api_optional_params: ResponsesAPIOptionalRequestParams, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
